column3: NKJV renders “Bethel sent Sharezer” as “the people sent Sherezer … to the house of God,” taking “Bethel” as “house of God” and supplying “the people.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shall I separate myself” is rendered “and fast.”
Close to the Hebrew; “these seventy years” is rendered “those seventy years.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “Should you not have obeyed,” and renders “the Negev and the Shephelah” “the South and the Lowland.”
Close to the Hebrew; “justice of faithfulness” is rendered “true justice,” and “loyalty” “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they gave a stubborn shoulder” is rendered “shrugged their shoulders,” and “made their ears heavy” “stopped their ears.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will storm them away” is rendered “I scattered them with a whirlwind,” and “a land of desire” “the pleasant land.”
